annotations.title: Get a link to upload a declarations page

description:
Use when the person attached their home or auto declarations page in this chat, or has it as a file with no public link. Returns upload_url, a link to an Eventual page where the person uploads the file, expiring at expires_at (60 minutes), and the upload_id. Give the person the link, wait until they say it's uploaded, then call read_declarations_page with the upload_id and the same email.

Premium Lock is not insurance or a financial derivative. Prices are set by Eventual's own pricing, not by the assistant. The person pays on eventualclimate.com; the assistant never charges anyone. Send only the fields a tool lists; never send conversation content or anything else about the person.
